# Luc Aractingi — Product Designer

> Product designer focused on AI experiences and human behaviour.

## About

Luc Aractingi is a product designer currently shaping AI experiences at Criteo. Previously at Yousign (QES signing flows) and Ignition Program (tech apprenticeship platform).

He studies how people behave, then designs impactful products around that.

## Work

- [Yousign — Reducing errors in QES](/yousign-qes): Research + Design · Mobile + Desktop (2025)
- [Ignition Program — Reshaping sign-up](/ignition-program): Research + Design · Mobile first (2023)
